query:
SELECT 1 AS "found!"
        FROM workflow_tasks t
        JOIN documents d ON d.id = t.document_id
        JOIN workflow_instances i ON i.id = t.workflow_instance_id
        WHERE t.tenant_id = $1 AND t.id = $2
        
          -- A task nobody can decide is not waiting for anybody, claimed or
          -- not (#530, #635, #762, #763, #761). Written once, here, and
          -- spliced into `list_for_caller`, `count_for_caller`,
          -- `is_visible_to` and `can_be_decided`. It is not
          -- `count_open_tasks_needing_role`'s clause, which asks whether
          -- *some* edge names a role: this asks whether *no* decision edge
          -- resolves. See "A task nobody can decide" at the top of the file.
          AND (t.status NOT IN ('CREATED', 'ASSIGNED', 'IN_PROGRESS')
               -- No decision edge at all, as on a RETURNED correction task that
               -- only RESUBMIT leaves: nothing to judge by, so it stays.
               OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM workflow_transitions tr
                              WHERE tr.tenant_id = t.tenant_id
                                AND tr.workflow_definition_id = i.workflow_definition_id
                                AND tr.from_state = i.current_state
                                AND tr.action IN ('APPROVE', 'REJECT', 'RETURN'))
               OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM workflow_transitions tr
                          WHERE tr.tenant_id = t.tenant_id
                            AND tr.workflow_definition_id = i.workflow_definition_id
                            AND tr.from_state = i.current_state
                            AND tr.action IN ('APPROVE', 'REJECT', 'RETURN')
                            -- A user, as `normalize` parses `userId` and
                            -- `direct` reads the user (#762): a JSON string,
                            -- since the engine reads any other JSON type as
                            -- no `userId` while `->>` would give a number's
                            -- digits; then the `uuid` crate's spellings, and
                            -- only those; then a live user of the tenant,
                            -- whatever their `status`. The CASE keeps the cast
                            -- from anything refused before it, so no `userId`
                            -- makes this raise.
                            AND ((tr.allowed_by_json->>'assigneeType' = 'USER'
                                  AND CASE
                                        WHEN jsonb_typeof(tr.allowed_by_json->'userId') = 'string'
                                             AND tr.allowed_by_json->>'userId'
                                             ~ '^([0-9a-fA-F]{32}|(urn:uuid:)?[0-9a-fA-F]{8}(-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}){3}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}|[{][0-9a-fA-F]{8}(-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}){3}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}[}])$'
                                        THEN EXISTS (
                                                 SELECT 1 FROM users u
                                                 WHERE u.tenant_id = t.tenant_id
                                                   AND u.id = replace(tr.allowed_by_json->>'userId',
                                                                      'urn:uuid:', '')::uuid
                                                   AND u.deleted_at IS NULL)
                                        ELSE false
                                      END)
                                 -- The owner is the creator, read as a user is.
                                 -- Not OWNER_DEPARTMENT's reading below, which
                                 -- ignores the creator's `deleted_at`.
                                 OR (tr.allowed_by_json->>'assigneeType' = 'OWNER'
                                     AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users u
                                                 WHERE u.tenant_id = t.tenant_id
                                                   AND u.id = d.created_by
                                                   AND u.deleted_at IS NULL))
                                 OR (tr.allowed_by_json->>'assigneeType'
                                         IN ('ROLE', 'DEPARTMENT_ROLE')
                                     AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM roles live
                                                 WHERE live.tenant_id = t.tenant_id
                                                   AND live.role_code = tr.allowed_by_json->>'roleCode'
                                                   AND live.deleted_at IS NULL)
                                     -- The department, as `normalize` and
                                     -- `direct` read it, live (#635). `ROLE`
                                     -- ignores a scope, as `normalize` does.
                                     -- The reserved words come before a code,
                                     -- and no scope is spelled out, or every
                                     -- unscoped DEPARTMENT_ROLE edge would fall
                                     -- to the code lookup and fail it.
                                     AND (tr.allowed_by_json->>'assigneeType' = 'ROLE'
                                          OR CASE
                                               WHEN tr.allowed_by_json->>'departmentScope' IS NULL
                                                    THEN true
                                               WHEN tr.allowed_by_json->>'departmentScope'
                                                        = 'REQUESTED_DEPARTMENT'
                                                    -- A live department of the
                                                    -- task's tenant, as
                                                    -- `direct` reads it (#763).
                                                    THEN EXISTS (
                                                        SELECT 1 FROM departments dep
                                                        WHERE dep.id = d.requested_for_department_id
                                                          AND dep.tenant_id = t.tenant_id
                                                          AND dep.deleted_at IS NULL)
                                               WHEN tr.allowed_by_json->>'departmentScope'
                                                        = 'OWNER_DEPARTMENT'
                                                    THEN EXISTS (
                                                        SELECT 1 FROM users u
                                                        JOIN departments dep
                                                          ON dep.id = u.department_id
                                                         AND dep.tenant_id = t.tenant_id
                                                         AND dep.deleted_at IS NULL
                                                        WHERE u.tenant_id = t.tenant_id
                                                          AND u.id = d.created_by)
                                               ELSE EXISTS (
                                                        SELECT 1 FROM departments dep
                                                        WHERE dep.tenant_id = t.tenant_id
                                                          AND dep.deleted_at IS NULL
                                                          AND dep.department_code
                                                              = tr.allowed_by_json->>'departmentScope')
                                             END)))))
